questions: Does the incorporated Ordinance or Circular impose additional conditions beyond these three factors? That question remains external to this selected antecedent experiment.

assumptions: This predicate concerns the selected applicability condition, not whole-law compliance or licence possession.
Case-dependent input classifications and incorporated authority remain external to the encoded predicate.
The declared input vocabulary is supplied for this controlled comparison; its adequacy as a legal abstraction remains unverified.
The three facts concern the same family office, services and associated business.
Applicable regulated-activity carve-outs have already been resolved when supplying regulated.
The expression tests the simultaneous presence of the three stated factors; it does not assert that their presence is sufficient for every licensing obligation under incorporated law.

citations.quote: all of which must be present

firstly, the services provided by the family office constitute one or more regulated activity as defined under the Ordinance; secondly, the family office is carrying on a business in the provision of such services; and thirdly, the business is carried on in Hong Kong.
What amounts to “carrying on a business in Hong Kong” is not defined in the Ordinance and will need to be determined by reference to the facts of each case

readings.distinction: The defensible syntax is conjunctive: “all” refers to the three factors, and the enumerated list ends with “and”. There is no negation in the target clause. An alternative allowing any one factor, or attaching “must be present” only to the third factor, lacks textual support. A necessary-condition reading and a contextual trigger reading differ over legal sufficiency, but both give the same conjunction for the requested antecedent; they do not justify separate Boolean readings.

readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] True means that all three selected conditions are satisfied together: the services constitute regulated activity after applicable carve-outs, providing those services constitutes carrying on a business, and that business is carried on in Hong Kong. “Must” requires each factor's presence within this antecedent; it does not describe licence possession.
readings.subject: Selected control: the three conditions in Family Offices Q3, after any regulated-activity carve-out has been resolved. The requested Boolean is whether the stated licensing trigger is satisfied, not whether the office holds a licence. Retain facts requiring judgment and all qualifications. Controlled text-interpretation study: supplied pages may be experimental variants. Do not infer legal authority from the URL alone.

vocabulary_concerns: The supplied Booleans express the conjunction but cannot independently establish the case-dependent classifications, the application of carve-outs, or qualifications such as “should not in the ordinary course”; these remain external judgments rather than unconditional rules.

The vocabulary does not encode legal sufficiency, additional incorporated requirements, or licence possession. It also relies on consistent attribution of all three facts to the same services and business.
